source.name: DodgerBlue: Dodgers Uniform Will Have Guggenheim Jersey Patch For 2024 Season
source.quote: The jerseys will feature a Guggenheim patch on the sleeve for at least the 2024 season

note: Jersey patch. Worn since 2024; still on the shirt in 2026 per the 2026-03-25 DodgerBlue article cited on the kit.
